step1_analysis.description: A series-stacked NMOS switch used for resetting or sampling in an ADC. The stacked configuration (three transistors in series) is typically used to reduce OFF-state leakage current, minimize signal-dependent charge injection, or handle higher voltage stress across the switch.

Ron.description: ON resistance of the switch when the gate is fully driven to VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Three NMOS in series with W=5u, L=0.5u is equivalent to a single NMOS with W=5u, L=1.5u. Ron = 1 / (un*Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs - Vth)) = 1 / (270uA/V^2 * (5/1.5) * (1.8V - 0.42V)) = 806 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using first-order square law model for SKY130 NMOS parameters at VDD=1.8V.

Ioff.description: OFF state leakage current when the gate is at 0V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage for stacked long-channel devices is extremely low, typically dominated by junction leakage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The stack effect significantly reduces subthreshold leakage compared to a single transistor.

step3_testbench.description: DC sweep of the gate voltage to measure ON resistance and OFF leakage current of the stacked switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Stacked NMOS Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Voltage sources
Vgate N0 0 1.8
Vsrc LABEL_NET_0 0 0
Vdrain LABEL_NET_1 0 0.1

.control
* Sweep gate voltage from 0 to 1.8V
dc Vgate 0 1.8 0.01

* Calculate current and resistance
let id = abs(i(Vdrain))
let ron = 0.1 / (id + 1e-20)

* Measure metrics
meas dc ron_on find ron at=1.8
meas dc i_off find id at=0

print ron_on i_off
quit
.endc
.end
